read_only_evidence_verification.scope: Evidence identity and selected reconstruction only; personal perception, mathematical validity, product behavior and audit closure are not verified.

privacy_scan.scope: Recursive gzip and tar over the archive; maximum depth 8 and per-view maximum 83,886,080 bytes.

result.qualification: Digest corpus is derived from restricted original GPU evidence, not hardcoded or printed. Text path/credential/email matches are candidates and require contextual classification; binary Git commit metadata remains separately disclosed. Per-view bytes and recursion depth are bounded; unsupported formats, excluded symlinks, unknown roots, encodings or credentials are not cleared. Git administrative metadata and history are omitted; the scan covers the specified working tree only. No product code is executed.

privacy_scan.limitation: Known private-value and prefix digest corpus plus selected path/credential patterns only; unknown paths, secrets, formats, encodings, Git history and binary metadata are not generally cleared. No Git commit bodies or author metadata included.

qualification: Additive receipt outside frozen archive, evidence-only; no assertion of product validation or lens closure.
